Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.vpn

Class VpnSettings

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.vpn.VpnSettings
public class VpnSettings extends Object
The VPN client's persisted preferences: which tunnel tool to prefer, whether to connect the last profile automatically on open, which profile that was, and whether to re-read the live connection state when the panel opens. A plain Jackson bean, so VpnStore round-trips it as JSON; every setter normalises its input so a hand-edited file can never produce an invalid nmcli line.

No secret is stored here - NetworkManager keeps its own VPN credentials and an imported config file keeps its own keys where the user left them.
